title: Supertake, which uses AI agents to turn users' market predictions into investment portfolios via Coinbase and Robinhood, raised a $20M seed led by Adjacent (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Supertake, which uses AI agents to turn users' market predictions into investment portfolios via Coinbase and Robinhood, raised a $20M seed led by Adjacent — AI investing startup Supertake has an interesting premise: what if your “takes” on the market could make you money without you having to pick stocks yourself?
